title: Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer
contents: text | Play this card to get an unexpected boon over your enemy.

title: My cousin Vinny.
contents: text | A long-lost family member contacts you. They claim to have something useful in your quest.

title: I’ll be back.
contents: text | You are immediately transported to another plane. While there you cannot be targeted or detected by another creature or character. You can stay for up to 1D6 combat turns. When you return you can pick any non-occupied spot on the battle map.

title: Yeah, I saw that going differently in my mind
contents: text | Play this card to get a single NPC or monster your character can see to do something downright dumb, dangerous or both.

title: I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse.
contents: text | Play on a merchant NPC. Maybe a store has a needed piece of equipment and it’s under-priced. Perhaps a rare item is found for sale. PCs pay for an item and discover it is of higher than normal quality.

title: I can do this all day
contents: text | Hero immediately regains all lost Hit Points. Hero also gains Endurance Feat.

title: Ice to meet you.
contents: text | All hero cold-based attacks are maximized until midnight or entering combat with any bat-creature or demon – whichever comes first.

title: May the Force be with you.
contents: text | Play during an encounter. Hero gains +3 to hit, +3 dodge bonus to A.C. & 2 Force attacks. Single target, 2d6 points damage & Bull Rush (as Ring of Ram), STR 25 Large, move objects with STR 25.

title: I am Groot
contents: text | You encounter a young Treant  (or ent). 1/2 size of an adult. It is willing to travel with you for a while as your personal houseplant/muscle.

title: A martini. Shaken, not stirred.
contents: text | Your reputation precedes you. Eat, drink and stay at one inn/tavern for free. +10 on gather information, diplomacy etc. checks while at this inn.

title: I have always depended on the kindness of strangers.
contents: text | Add 5 to one gather Information or diplomacy encounter in town.

title: It was Beauty killed the Beast.
contents: property | must be played during an encounter
text | For one encounter all female heroes & villains add 1d8 to their damage

title: It's alive! It's alive!
contents: property | must be played during an encounter
text | You can resurrect 1 monster up to your level in hit dice. It will serve you for 24 hours.

title: Greed, for lack of a better word, is good.
contents: property | must be played before coins are discovered
text | Double all coins in a treasure hoard.

title: I like to move it, move it.
contents: property | must be played during an encounter
text | Combat stops. In the confusion all heroes have 2 rounds of free movement, except they cannot make contact with opponents.

title: Say "hello" to my little friend!
contents: property | must be played during an encounter
text | One encounter. Hero melee weapon does an additional 1d6 damage per round and hero gains the same in temporary hit points that round.

title: Like a box of chocolates.
contents: text | You come upon a small, rectangular wooden box. 18 inches by 12 inches by 6 inches. It is covered in many runes of a forgotten tongue and has a sliding lid… now what could be inside…?

title: There's no place like home.
contents: text | You find 2 Teleportation runestones. Set one at a location you wish to return to and when the other is activated, it will teleport up to 4 PCs to the first location. 5 charges.

title: I feel the need - the need for speed!
contents: property | must be played during a journey
text | Conditions are good! Double all transport speeds for one day

title: I love the smell of arcane fire in the morning.
contents: text | The next 5 evocations spells the hero casts will be maximized.

title: I'm the king of the world!
contents: text | You have 24 hours to do the following: Win a bet with an NPC or monster; Wear borrowed armor for 1 hour; Sacrifice yourself for a female teammate; and discard a personal magic item. Failure has consequences.

title: Yippie Ki-yay!
contents: text | Hero has DR 10/- for the duration of the next fight/ combat encounter or trap. Also gain the Die-Hard Feat

title: I'm your huckleberry.
contents: property | must be played during an encounter
text | Group combat only. Combat stops. Hero and the opposing leader settle the fight one-on-one.

title: ..and I’m all outta bubble gum.
contents: text | Take a number of actions without penalty up to your dexterity modifier +2 for the duration of the encounter.

title: You shall not pass
contents: text | Hero gains Attacks of Opportunity vs all foes in a 15’ radius. Only one AoO per foe each round in the 15’ threat area.

title: Hasta la vista, baby.
contents: text | When the hero speaks this line, his next strike will be a Natural 20.

title: I'll get you and your little dog, too!
Come here often?
contents: text | Play on an NPC to encourage a romantic interest for your hero. The NPC helps to the best of his/her abilities- but all relationships come with a bit of trouble don’t they?

title: I love it when a plan comes together!
contents: text | Your next encounter plan comes off without a hitch.

title: My name is Bond. James Bond.
contents: text | Play on an NPC. Because of your reputation– you make a new ally. NPC will do all they can to help you out… within reason.

title: Well, do ya… punk?
contents: property | must be played during an encounter
text | Ranged Hero gets an extra ranged attack (at lowest attack modifier).

title: It’s the fastest hunk of junk in the galaxy
contents: text | Use with any transport to double movement speed, endurance and hit points for 1 encounter.

title: Houston, we have a problem.
contents: text | When the hero speaks this line, the Bad Guy’s next strike is a natural 1 - with penalty.

title: This is Sparta!
contents: text | During your next encounter, add 3 to all attack stats. If opponent is a leader, or opposite you in alignment, add 6 to all attack stats.

title: It’s a trap!
contents: text | Hero avoids all penalties from the next trap.

title: Well-well-well… What have we here?
contents: text | Revelation! You find all the information available when doing research or realize critical information when confronting some obstacle such as a monster’s weakness, the answer to a riddle, cipher, etc.

title: Revenge is a dish best served cold.
contents: text | Remember that bad guy you took care of a while back? Well, they’re back and looking for revenge.

title: I make this look good.
contents: text | Roll a d10, you discover:

title: We're not in Kansas anymore.
contents: text | Must be played on your next town visit. All locals view you as a welcome oddity. They fawn over you and become a general nuisance. Gain Magical Aptitude feat.

title: I am Ironman
contents: text | Play this card and your local blacksmith trades any +1 enhancement to your armor in exchange for your help.

title: Somebody get that kid a sandwich
contents: text | Hero gains 15 temporary hit points, +3 to strength and dexterity modifiers for one Encounter.

title: Dying ain’t much of a living, boy.
contents: text | Hero Gains +5 to any in-town encounter. Hero also gains Quick Draw Feat.

title: Let's work  this out.
contents: text | After 2 rounds of combat you can come to a truce out of mutual respect. Hero gains Negotiator Feat.

title: You’re not afraid of the dark are you?
contents: text | For the next 12 hours you have Darkvision 120’. However, any artificial light source reduces sight to 20’ & sunlight blinds you.

title: That’s not a knife.
contents: text | For one encounter any dagger becomes +5 with Speed, Wounding, Brilliant Energy, & Shock properties.

title: Hello! Prepare to die!
contents: text | During one encounter hero has +7 bonus to all strikes vs. targeted opponent.

title: I’m a doctor not a dragonslayer.
contents: text | Hero finds a discarded potion of heal. 2 doses.

title: StarLord. Finally!
contents: text | Hero gains +7 to all Intimidate & Feint attempts during the next encounter.

title: I ain’t got time to bleed
contents: text | Heal half of your total hit points when played. Gain the feat: Toughness. Can be traded.

title: I will have my vengeance
contents: text | In battle, if reduced to less than 10 HP, Hero gains 10 HP and next attack is a natural 20. One use.

title: Are we having fun yet?
contents: text | Use in town only. You are the life of the party! D.M. grants you 1 Miracle & 1 Wish spell that must be used to benefit as many people as possible. Succeed & gain the Skill Focus feat.

title: Show me the money!
contents: text | Play at a NPC encounter. You negotiate a deal in your favor for triple pay or  50% discount.

title: I am the Law!
contents: text | One of your Hero’s weapons becomes Lawful Good Holy for one encounter. If played in town– all authority sees you as a valuable ally & will do all to assist you in your quest.

title: You’re the disease and I’m the cure.
contents: text | All divine spells maxed for one encounter. Card may be traded.
